result.instructions: Tools for Freshdesk, hosted by usefulapi.io. Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Freshdesk data. Free plan: 100 tool calls per month. Run freshdesk_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run freshdesk_request_feature to record the request. Pro (unlimited calls, $9/month or $90/year): when the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run freshdesk_upgrade; it returns a Stripe Checkout link for the user to open. freshdesk_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_tickets
tools.title: List tickets
tools.description: List/filter tickets (max page 300). Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets.

filter.description: Predefined filter: new_and_my_open, watching, spam, or deleted.

updated_since.description: Only tickets updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

order_by.description: Sort field: created_at, due_by, updated_at, or status.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_ticket
tools.title: Get ticket
tools.description: Get a single ticket by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}.

include.description: Embed extra data, comma-separated: conversations, requester, company, stats.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_tickets
tools.title: Search tickets
tools.description: Search tickets with the Freshdesk query DSL. The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples: `status:2 AND priority:3`, `created_at:>'2026-01-01'`, `agent_id:123`, `group_id:45`, `tag:'urgent'`. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/tickets.

query.description: Freshdesk search query, e.g. "priority:3 AND status:2" (do NOT add surrounding quotes yourself — they are added for you).

page.description: Page number (1-10; search endpoints return 30 results per page and ignore per_page).

tools.name: freshdesk_list_ticket_conversations
tools.title: List ticket conversations
tools.description: List the conversations (replies and notes) on a ticket. Freshdesk REST: GET /tickets/{id}/conversations.

updated_since.description: Only contacts updated after this ISO 8601 timestamp.

state.description: Filter by state: verified, unverified, blocked, or deleted.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_contact
tools.title: Get contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /contacts/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_search_contacts
tools.title: Search contacts
tools.description: Search contacts with the Freshdesk query DSL. The query VALUE is wrapped in double quotes automatically. Examples: `name:'ada'`, `email:'ada@example.com'`, `company_id:123`. Freshdesk REST: GET /search/contacts.

query.description: Freshdesk search query, e.g. "company_id:123" (do NOT add surrounding quotes yourself — they are added for you).

page.description: Page number (1-10; search endpoints return 30 results per page and ignore per_page).

tools.name: freshdesk_get_company
tools.title: Get company
tools.description: Get a single company by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /companies/{id}.

state.description: Filter by state: fulltime or occasional.

tools.name: freshdesk_get_agent
tools.title: Get agent
tools.description: Get a single agent by id. Freshdesk REST: GET /agents/{id}.

tools.name: freshdesk_list_groups
tools.title: List groups
tools.description: List groups (agent groups tickets are routed to). Freshdesk REST: GET /groups.

tools.name: freshdesk_create_ticket
tools.title: Create ticket
tools.description: Create a ticket. `subject` and `description` (HTML) are required, plus a requester — provide at least one of `email`, `requester_id`, or `phone`. status: 2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed. priority: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent. source: 1=Email, 2=Portal, 3=Phone, 7=Chat, 9=Feedbackwidget, 10=Outbound email. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets.

cc_emails.description: Emails to CC on the ticket.

group_id.description: Id of the group to assign the ticket to.

responder_id.description: Id of the agent the ticket is assigned to.

company_id.description: Id of the company the ticket belongs to.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by field name.

tools.name: freshdesk_update_ticket
tools.title: Update ticket
tools.description: Update fields on an existing ticket. Only provided fields are changed. status: 2=Open, 3=Pending, 4=Resolved, 5=Closed. priority: 1=Low, 2=Medium, 3=High, 4=Urgent. Freshdesk REST: PUT /tickets/{id}.

group_id.description: Id of the group to assign the ticket to.

responder_id.description: Id of the agent the ticket is assigned to.

company_id.description: Id of the company the ticket belongs to.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by field name.

tools.name: freshdesk_reply_ticket
tools.title: Reply to ticket
tools.description: Add a public reply to a ticket (sent to the requester). Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/reply.

id.description: The ticket id to reply to.

cc_emails.description: Emails to CC on the reply.

bcc_emails.description: Emails to BCC on the reply.

tools.name: freshdesk_add_note
tools.title: Add note to ticket
tools.description: Add a note to a ticket. Notes are internal (private) by default; set `private: false` for a public note. Freshdesk REST: POST /tickets/{id}/notes.

id.description: The ticket id to add a note to.

private.description: Whether the note is internal/private (default true). Set false for a public note.

notify_emails.description: Agent emails to notify about this note.

tools.title: Create contact
tools.description: Create a contact. `name` is required. Freshdesk REST: POST /contacts.

company_id.description: Id of the company the contact belongs to.

unique_external_id.description: External id from your own system.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values, keyed by field name.
